pid.description: The pid twilight intends a process at on this node; never 0, which names no process, and never the default shell's pid, 17505437192229758416, which is no intended process's own.

principal.description: Who asked for the process: the campaign's creator or the operator.

subject.description: What the process is for: campaign:<campaign_id>, or the operator who asked for it.

created_at.description: When twilight first recorded the process.

expires_at.description: After this, every call under the pid but Dusk.kill and Dusk.waitpid is refused. Twilight moves it later on every resend.

max_commands.description: How many ShPortal.sh calls the shell at the pid may take, summed over every send of the process; 0 for a process that runs no shell of its own, like a reap.

default_shell_commands.description: How many ShPortal.sh calls the node's default shell may take on this process's behalf while it is open, summed over every send.
